name: linkedin-warm-leads
description: Find warm LinkedIn leads in what you already have, from one line: which LinkedIn post comments come from potential clients, replies to comments that move people to a DM or a call, a LinkedIn follow-up plan for a DM thread that went quiet, and which LinkedIn connections in your own LinkedIn export are warm. Turns LinkedIn engagement into conversations. Works from comments or messages you paste, one post URL you give, your LinkedIn data export, and, when you ask, LinkedIn notification emails in your connected mail or a check of names in your CRM. Drafts only: never sends, never logs in to LinkedIn, never looks people up on LinkedIn or the web.

interface.shortDescription: Turn LinkedIn comments, DMs and your network into conversations
interface.longDescription: Five skills for the LinkedIn activity you already have. Sort the people who commented on your post into potential clients, peers and vendors pitching you, with a DM draft for the best few. Draft public replies to comments that keep the thread going and move people who show a need toward a call. Turn a quiet DM thread into a follow-up plan with the next message ready to paste. Rank the connections in your own LinkedIn data export by real shared history, and learn what the export contains. Works from what you paste, one post URL you give, your export, or LinkedIn notification emails in your connected mail when you ask. Nothing is sent, LinkedIn is never opened on its own and nobody is looked up.
defaultPrompt: Who in the comments of my LinkedIn post is a potential client? I sell fractional RevOps to B2B SaaS teams. <paste the comments>
Draft replies to these LinkedIn comments that move people to a call: <paste the comments>
Turn this LinkedIn DM thread into a follow-up plan: <paste the thread>
